about: Renders a heading in a heading text role, a text ink, a text effect and an entrance motion. `as` sets the heading level.

display.about: The heading at size `2xl` in the heading text role and in the display text role. The display role is heavier and tighter.
display.title: Display

effect.about: `gradient` fills the words with a gradient. `shine` moves a highlight across them.
effect.title: Effects

migration: Migrate every workspace to the new billing plan before the end of the quarter

motion.about: The animation a heading enters with. Each one runs once when the heading mounts.
motion.title: Motion

size.about: The eight steps of the heading text role. `size` sets the prominence and `as` sets the level.
size.title: Sizes

title: Heading

tone.about: Every text ink. The inverted ink is for a dark surface, so its cell renders on `bg.inverted`.
tone.title: Inks

truncate.about: A heading that wraps, and the same heading cut to one line with an ellipsis, in a 512px room.
truncate.title: Truncate
